forum.title: Is Samsung K4FBE3D4HM-TFCL LPDDR4 compatible with Micron MT53E1G32D2FW-046 WT:C
forum.category: STM32 MPUs Products and hardware related
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@Windows,

Based on the information compared, I believe the Samsung reference should work, but just in case, there are other part numbers on the wiki that have already been validated by ST here is the link [Validated DRAM on STM32 MPU portfolio - stm32mpu](https://wiki.st.com/stm32mpu/wiki/Validated_DRAM_on_STM32_MPU_portfolio)

Best Regards,

Zakaria
forum.content_text:
I’m looking for a replacement of MT53E1G32D2FW-046 WT:C because it’s out of stock.

So, I have found Samsung K4FBE3D4HM-TFCL LPDD4. From what I can see, it’s compatible with MT53E1G32D2FW-046 WT:C:

* Same voltage

* Same package

* Same pinout

* Single rank

* Follows JEDEC standard

Are there anything else I need to know before making an order of that LPDDR4 memory?
